title: H.R. McMaster says Putin, Xi see U.S. as "weak, decadent and divided"
summary: President Trump arrived in China ahead of his meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, a former adviser to President Trump, shares his thoughts on the summit.

title: Ex-Google Engineer May Face New Charges Over Bets on Gemini 3.0
summary: A former Google software engineer accused of making an illegal bet on Polymarket about company search data may face additional charges that he also traded on the release date of its Gemini 3.0 artificial-intelligence model.

title: Texas Resumes Data Center Environmental Permits After Pause
summary: Texas regulators have resumed reviewing applications for data centers, bringing an end to an effective moratorium on environmental permitting for the power-hungry facilities.

title: McDonald's sex abuse: 'They were waiting for the younger girls to turn 18'
summary: A former McDonald's worker calls on the firm to “change the way they treat younger employees” as a judge rules a legal case against the chain can go ahead.

title: Nvidia Turmoil Spurs Valuation Rethink of Japan’s AI Shares
